$comment: Everything shown when something is wrong: the 404 page, the route error boundary, and the messages the calculators show for input they cannot use. Input messages say what to do, never only that something failed.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.metaDescription: That page does not exist on DevExCalculator.org.

popular.usdToRobux: Work out the Earned Robux needed for a payout target
popular.requirements: Check the DevEx minimum and requirements

intro.p1: title: "Page not found", description: "That page does not exist on DevExCalculator.org.", robots:
intro.p2: The address may have changed, or the link that brought you here may be wrong. Nothing has been deleted — this site has never had a page at this address.

boundary.title: Something went wrong on this page
boundary.reference: If you report this, quote reference {digest}.

intro.p1: The calculator itself is unaffected — calculations run in your browser and do not depend on this page loading. Try again, or go straight to the calculator.
intro.p2: If you report this, quote reference .

input.notANumber: That is not a number this calculator can read.
input.ambiguous: Write this with a decimal separator this language uses, so {value} cannot be read two ways.
input.negative: Enter an amount of zero or more.
input.tooLarge: That amount is larger than this calculator will accept.
input.robuxMustBeWhole: Robux come in whole units — enter a whole number.
input.belowMinimum: That is below the {minimum} Earned Robux minimum, so it cannot be exchanged yet.
input.rateUnavailable: No verified rate applies to that combination.

form.invalidEmail: Enter an email address that can receive a reply.
form.messageTooShort: Add a little more detail so this can be looked into.
form.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Nothing was saved — try again, or email directly.
form.rateLimited: Too many messages from this address. Try again later.

data.unavailable: This data could not be loaded.
data.stale: This data is older than it should be, and is shown with the time it was collected rather than as current.
data.noObservations: No observations have been recorded yet, so there is nothing to show here.
